single_shot_60s.global_prompt: integrated_multimodal_description: [One continuous live-action music-video, single singer] A young East Asian male singer in his late twenties, short black hair, wearing a midnight-blue velvet jacket over a white tee, stands alone on a softly lit rooftop at dusk. The camera stays on a natural medium portrait framing with gentle, motivated movement. The performance is photorealistic, emotionally expressive, and never becomes animation or stylization.

segments.prompt: [Same shot, opening] The man takes a breath, looks to camera, and begins the first verse in a quiet, intimate tone, his mouth moving precisely with the vocals: <d>[Chinese] 城市的灯都亮了，我还在等你的回音。</d> A faint breeze moves his jacket; the rope lights on the railing glow softly. Keep his identity, velvet jacket, rooftop, dusk sky, and perfect lip-sync unchanged.

[Same shot, continuation] The leading phrase resolves as he builds into the pre-chorus with more energy, shifting his weight and gesturing with one hand, mouth perfectly in sync: <d>[Chinese] 如果时间能倒回，我多想再听你说一遍。</d> The dusk deepens into a purple-blue sky; keep the same man, jacket, framing, and lip-sync, no cut.

[Same shot, continuation] He delivers the chorus with full, passionate delivery, head lifting and eyes bright, articulation wide and rhythmic, mouth locked to every syllable: <d>[Chinese] 我把思念写进风里，等你吹回我身边。</d> A subtle push-in frames his face; intensity rises while his identity, jacket, rooftop, and background stay identical.

[Same shot, continuation] The chorus settles and he carries a sustained note, jaw and lips controlled and precise, voice softening: <d>[Chinese] 就算世界都沉默，我也为你唱这一首。</d> The camera eases back to the medium portrait as city lights brighten behind him; lip-sync remains exact.

[Same shot, continuation] He finishes the final phrase quietly, a gentle smile as the last notes end, lips closing naturally: <d>[Chinese] 晚安，等你在梦的尽头。</d> The night sky holds steady; keep the same man, costume, rooftop, and framing throughout, no other characters.

[Same shot, continuation] The aerial view holds over the winding river as morning mist finally thins. The voice pauses on the sound of wind and water before continuing: <d>[Chinese] 时间在这里，走得很慢，也很温柔。</d> Same continuous camera, same valley, no subjects.

single_shot_60s.global_prompt: integrated_multimodal_description: [One continuous dimly lit intimate drama, two characters] A middle-aged man and woman sit facing each other at a small wooden table in a cramped, warmly lit Chinese city apartment at night. Tension and tenderness alternate as they argue and reconcile in Mandarin dialogue. The scene is photorealistic live-action, shallow depth of field, close medium shots, natural handheld subtlety and no hard cuts within each segment. No subtitles.

segments.prompt: [Same shot, opening] The man looks down, then speaks quietly, voice strained: <d>[Chinese] 这些年，我一直没敢跟你说真话。</d> The woman watches him, jaw tight, the ceiling lamp casting soft shadows; keep their faces and the small wooden table identical.

[Same shot, continuation] She replies with rising hurt, leaning forward: <d>[Chinese] 那你现在说，我想听。</d> He meets her eyes, a long beat; the same tight framing, warm lamp, and quiet room tone continue, no cut.

[Same shot, continuation] He admits his feelings with a softer voice, reaching for her hand: <d>[Chinese] 我是怕失去你，才一直瞒着。</d> She blinks, expression softening; the shallow focus holds on their faces, same setting and lighting.

[Same shot, continuation] She laughs lightly through the emotion, shaking her head: <d>[Chinese] 你呀，总是把心事藏得那么深。</d> He almost smiles, shoulders easing; their faces and the warm apartment remain identical, dialogue crisp and readable.

[Same shot, continuation] They hold a quiet moment, then he murmurs: <d>[Chinese] 从今往后，我什么都告诉你。</d> She nods, taking his hand; the frame holds as the lamp flickers gently, same two people, same room, no cut, no text.
